name: gate_twin_findings_one_hunk
about: Two distinct findings inside one hunk. Both must post: identity is built from the quoted code and the category, so neighbours in the same change cannot collapse into one.
diff:
diff --git a/ledger.py b/ledger.py
--- a/ledger.py
+++ b/ledger.py
@@ -1,6 +1,3 @@
 def transfer(src, dst, amount):
-    if amount <= 0:
-        raise ValueError(amount)
-    with LOCK:
-        src.balance -= amount
-        dst.balance += amount
+    src.balance -= amount
+    dst.balance += amount

findings.title: Amount is no longer checked to be positive
